about: An informational letter whose explanation denies a need: 'In other words, you will not need to buy tail coverage when the assignment ends'. A need denied asks for nothing, so the letter stays informational with its one insurance record. Synthetic.
subject: Your liability coverage for the spring assignment
body:
Dr. Testa,

Marrowby Locum Partners provides your professional liability insurance for this assignment, $1,000,000 per claim and $3,000,000 aggregate. The policy is written on an occurrence basis. In other words, you will not need to buy tail coverage when the assignment ends.

Kind regards,
Ellis Varga
Recruiting Manager
Marrowby Locum Partners
Mobile: 406.555.0188
